name: BuildAlphaStatePacket
evidence: builds a GIF packet that writes GS register 0x47 (TEST_1) with 0x7180B and register 0x42 (ALPHA_1) from its index, detached into the word it is given

name: InitAlphaStatePackets
evidence: entry 23 of the startup table D_002647C0: builds the packets of g_alphaStatePacket1 and g_alphaStatePacket2 with BuildAlphaStatePacket (indices 1 and 2)

name: AcquireOwnedRecord
evidence: takes a 0x10C0-byte record from the pool at +0x1B40, clears it, sets its owner (and an extra 0x580-byte record when the owner's mode is 2) and links it into the owner's list at +0x624

name: DetachOwnedRecord
evidence: removes the record from its owner's list at +0x624 (owner at 0x108C) and appends it to the list D_002622F0

name: ResetFirstListedObject
evidence: takes the first object of the world list at +0x1CC0, sets flag bits, clears +0x2D0 and +0x620, sets +0x80 to 1e10 and calls its slot 6

name: InitWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 0: adds itself to its world's list at +0x1CC0, sets up members and sets flags and the float at 0x80

name: LeaveWorldLists
evidence: slot 6: removes itself from its world's lists at +0x1CC0 and +0x1CB4

name: ReleaseWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 7: walks the members list calling func_00139D28 on each, then removes itself from the world list at +0x1CB4 and D_002622E0

name: AssignAnimRecord
evidence: stores at 0x380 the record FindAnimRecord finds (g_animRecords when none), on the first call copies its four bytes at +4 halved into 0x594, then RebuildAnimRecordEntries

name: RebuildAnimRecordEntries
evidence: from the count in the record's block (byte at +4) picks a power of two below 0x20 for 0x384 and fills the 16-byte entries at 0x390 with func_001B2988; AssignAnimRecord and UpdateMatchingListedObjects call it

name: ApplyLookSourceToListedObject
evidence: copies colour count, colours (halved) and timing fields of a look record into a world-listed object, assigns its animation record, derives its rate from the register count and remaps the record's quadratic into curve2F0

name: UpdateWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 17: runs base updates then, unless the flagRecord's flags satisfy the global mask, calls its own method 3

name: CopyWorldListedObject
evidence: slot 23: copies from the source object and, when it is of class 0x50, keeps it as source and takes its float at 0x80

name: FilterParticleVerticesVu0
evidence: original assembly: loads a matrix into VU0 and runs the microprogram (vcallms 0x10) over an array of vertices, keeping those that pass the w test and wrapping the interpolated angle (WrapAngle) in kind 2 output

name: StepListedObjectParticles
evidence: original assembly: starts min and max bounds at plus and minus 3.4e38, moves particles in scratchpad chunks (StartToSprChain and StartFromSprChain DMA, FilterParticleVerticesVu0, TurnMatrixBySpin) and removes the particles the filter rejects (count and the object's total at +0x620 drop by its result), detaches a record left empty, and when particles remain recentres the object on the middle of the bounds (slot 0x1D) and sets its radius at +0x2A4/+0x2A8; otherwise destroys the object

name: MoveWorldListedObject
evidence: class 0x4D's slot at 0x7C, the move slot of the other classes (MoveStateNotifier, MoveModeCollider)

name: SubmitWorldListedObjectBlock
evidence: slot 37: builds a zeroed 0x80-byte parameter block (count 0xF, radius from the source or 1.0, owner itself) and passes it to func_0019D410

name: WriteListedObjectParticlePacket
evidence: original assembly: the deferred-request function SubmitWorldListedObjectBlock installs: writes VIF unpack and STCYCL words and copies the particle words (CopyWordsToWriter) into the packet for each chunk of the listed object

name: UpdateMatchingListedObjects
evidence: for a nonzero mask walks the world list at +0x1CB4 and calls func_0013A008 on each object whose flag record has bit 0x10000000 or all of the mask's bits
